task: Extract Purser as a standalone Apache-2.0 project: lift the 1,267 lines of agent policy code out of the InFlow fork, replace their storage with our own, and prove zero dependency on InFlow.
constraints: Zero InFlow code, packages or references in src/. This is the whole point of the extraction and is gated by grep.
Apache-2.0, matching @x402/core and @x402/evm which carry a patent grant. Not MIT.
The fork at RegardV/inflow-cli-agents stays intact. It remains the reference implementation backing the argument to InFlow; it does not become the product.
Test count must not drop. 112 came across; fewer means something was silently lost.
No em-dashes in any file, per the standing rule.

n1.desc: Scaffold the purser package: package.json, tsconfig, vitest config, Apache-2.0 LICENSE, README
n1.accept: All five files exist, LICENSE is Apache-2.0, package.json is named purser with no inflow dependency

n2.desc: Lift envelope, allowance, credential, intent, ledger, store, enforcement and gate; write our own storage layer and index; rewrite every import
n2.accept: All ten modules exist and grep finds zero references to inflow anywhere in src

n3.desc: Migrate the test suite against the new module paths and the new storage layer
n3.accept: The suite passes with at least 100 tests and zero failures
